description.value:
奇物，珍稀（需同調）
這對漆黑的腿甲上裝飾着無數恐懼中尖叫的可怖顱骨。
這對腿甲有3發充能。着裝這對腿甲期間，你可以用一個附贈動作，消耗1發充能以令你的步行速度增加30尺且在敏捷豁免上具有優勢。這些效應持續1分鐘。腿甲在每日黎明恢復[[/r 1d3]]發已消耗的充能
詛咒Cursed。腿甲被詛咒了，而與腿甲同調會令你也被詛咒。你無法卸下腿甲直到同調結束或者你被法術@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.ewDH2w8w2yLSM021]{移除詛咒 Remove Curse}或類似魔法指定爲目標。
你在爲抵抗恐慌狀態而進行的豁免具有劣勢。每當你在陷入恐慌期間開始回合時，腿甲都會釋放一道刺耳的尖嘯。你和每個位於你10尺內的生物都必須進行一次[[/save ability=con dc=15]]豁免，豁免失敗者受到9（[[/damage 2d8 type=thunder]]）雷鳴傷害，豁免成功則傷害減半。

Each of these black leg guards is decorated with a motif of monstrous skulls screaming in terror.

The greaves have 3 charges. While wearing these greaves, you can use a bonus action to expend 1 charge to increase your walking speed by 30 feet, and you have advantage on Dexterity saving throws. These effects last for 1 minute. The greaves regain [[/r 1d3]] expended charges daily at dawn.

Curse. The greaves are cursed, and becoming attuned to them extends the curse to you. You can't remove the greaves or end your attunement to them until you are targeted by a @spell[Remove Curse] spell or similar magic.

You have disadvantage on saving throws against the frightened condition. Whenever you start your turn frightened, the greaves release an ear-piercing scream. You and each creature within 10 feet of you must make a [[/save ability=con dc=15]] saving throw, taking 9 ([[/damage 2d8 type=thunder]]) damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
